editorial_reason: Direct ProofWiki Definition 1. Countable-union and relative-complement conditions are not interchangeable with arbitrary-union topological axioms; X may be empty. Do not equate sigma-algebra with topology.

Direct ProofWiki Definition 2. Values may be +infinity; zero on the empty set and countable additivity for pairwise disjoint measurable sets are explicit. Do not infer probability normalization μ(X)=1 or finite total mass.
